# Kestrel Ralli (`kestrel_ralli`) — spec sheet

## Design note

A sleeper sedan with a big turbo hit: lazy below 2500 rpm, then a wall of torque that tugs the wheel. Front-drive in stock form, so it is about managing torque steer and wheelspin out of junctions; the drivetrain mod converts it to the all-wheel-drive rally-bred variant the name hints at.

## How this car breaks

Mid-2000s HSS cabin with decent front rails: it survives a 56 km/h frontal with the cabin intact but the intercooler and radiator are first in line, so a moderate nose hit leaves it limping on overheat. Four doors means four weak spots in a T-bone.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for mid-2000s 2.0 T sport sedans
- owner chassis-dyno averages for 2.0 L turbo I4s on stock boost
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 644 | 0.80 | 510 |
| pitch | 2859 | 0.90 | 2570 |
| yaw | 2986 | 0.92 | 2750 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 2.16 m²; Cd = 0.31 → **CdA = 0.668 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.08 / +0.10 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

2.0 L DOHC I4, single turbo, intercooled, plateau 2500-4500 rpm. Class-typical 2000s 2.0 T: ~90 kW/L, torque plateau limited by the factory boost map; spool shape from owner dyno averages.

| rpm | N·m | kW |
|---|---|---|
| 1000 | 150 | 15.7 |
| 1500 | 205 | 32.2 |
| 2000 | 280 | 58.6 |
| 2500 | 330 | 86.4 |
| 3000 | 335 | 105.2 |
| 3500 | 335 | 122.8 |
| 4000 | 333 | 139.5 |
| 4500 | 325 | 153.2 |
| 5000 | 310 | 162.3 |
| 5500 | 295 | 169.9 |
| 6000 | 288 | 181.0 |
| 6500 | 262 | 178.3 |
| 6800 | 240 | 170.9 |

Peak **181 kW @ 6000 rpm**, **335 N·m @ 3000 rpm**. Idle 800 / redline 6500 / limiter 6800 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.13 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 11% of peak torque = 37 N·m. Power-to-weight 123 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual, mild clutch-type front LSD (AWD centre coupling is a mod). Layout **FWD**; front diff: clutch LSD, preload 40 N·m, power ramp 0.30, coast ramp 0.10; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.35 × peak torque = 450 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.54 | 14.37 | 52 |
| 2 | 2.13 | 8.65 | 87 |
| 3 | 1.48 | 6.01 | 125 |
| 4 | 1.12 | 4.55 | 166 |
| 5 | 0.89 | 3.61 | 209 |
| 6 | 0.73 | 2.96 | 254 |

Final drive 4.06, reverse 3.30. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.308 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 428 kg | 1.50 Hz | 38000 N/m | 2420 N·s/m | 3630 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 268 kg | 1.60 Hz | 27000 N/m | 1610 N·s/m | 2420 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.0°/g with 55% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.424 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 117284 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 44485 F / 31245 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **8600 F / 9300 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.0°/g, front share 55%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.7° F / -1.2° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 4.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 57 mm → A = 25.5 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·25.5 cm²·0.125 m = **2552 N·m**
- Rear: 280 mm disc, pistons per side 38 mm → A = 11.3 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 115 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·11.3 cm²·0.115 m = **1043 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1796 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.42×), rear needs 430 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.42×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.78 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 830 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.2 m → outer-front path radius 5.49 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.05 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.578 rad (33.1°)** (outer 28.8°, inner 38.8° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/kestrel_ralli.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id kestrel_ralli --width 1.77 --length 4.6 --height 1.45 --wheelbase 2.64 --mass 324.5 --clearance 0.14` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `sedan` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 4.5e-04 m² (34 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 4.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 5.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 2.5e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 4.5e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → aluminum 1.5e-4 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), transverse engine at row 7 with the gearbox on its left end, fuel tank under the rear seat.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 3500 N·s / 9 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 325 kg total.
